title: Evaluation of air polishing with a sterile powder and mecha nical debridement during regenerative surgical periimplantitis treatment: a study in dogs
authors: Solderer A, Pippenger BE, Donnet M, Wiedemeier D, Ramenzoni LL, Schmidlin PR. Clin Oral Investig. 2021 May;25(5):2609-2618. doi: 10.1007/s00784-020-03572-2.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “All treatments resulted in partial regeneration of the defects. No treatment group showed a significantly (p < 0.05) better outcome. However, pretreatment with air polishing showed a tendency for less inflammation. Noteworthy, inflammation assessment showed an overall irritative potential after GBR in the evaluated early healing phase” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
